summary: Dominion Energy South Carolina filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of 2026 Series A First Mortgage Bonds due October 1, 2056, secured by substantially all electric utility properties not released from the indenture lien. BNP Paribas and Scotiabank are joint book-running managers; pricing, principal amount, coupon and settlement date are left blank pending completion. Interest pays semi-annually April 1 and October 1 from April 1, 2027, redeemable at any time plus accrued interest, or at 101% on a Tax Credit Event. This is an ordinary debt shelf takedown, not a special situation.
